jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established manufacturer of high-quality coffins, supplying products with a strong focus on craftsmanship, precision, and quality. To strengthen the production team in Drongen, we are looking for a motivated Machine Operator for the carpentry department.

Jobomschrijving

As a Machine Operator in the carpentry department, you will be responsible for various woodworking and production tasks, including:

• Operating planing, sawing, and gluing machines
• Processing and assembling wooden components
• Performing quality checks on finished products
• Ensuring production targets and quality standards are met
• Maintaining a clean and safe working environment

We are looking for someone who:

• Has experience operating production or woodworking machines
• Has forklift experience or a valid forklift certificate (an advantage)
• Is not afraid of physical work
• Can communicate in Dutch, English, or French (Polish is also welcome)
• Is reliable, motivated, and quality-conscious

Production of high-quality wooden coffins.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, located in Drongen, we are looking for a Wood Production Worker - Day Shift (8:00 AM - 4:00 PM).

You will contribute to the production of high-quality wooden coffins and play an important role in the finishing process.

Your responsibilities

• Removing wooden boards from the profiling machine
• Performing quality checks on the wooden boards
• Feeding wooden boards into the wide belt sanding machine

Are you the Wood Production Worker we are looking for?

• You have a stable work history and enjoy hands-on work.
• You have an interest in wood and woodworking. Experience is a plus, but certainly not required.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch or English.
• You are accurate, punctual, and reliable.
• You do not see repetitive work as a challenge, but as an opportunity to deliver quality and efficiency.

You will ensure that the installation runs optimally and continuously monitor the quality and efficiency.

• Taking responsibility for the process until the grated carrots arrive in the production hall, where the further process is taken over by the team

• Technically minded and able to monitor and adjust machines

• Experience as an operator or in a production environment is a plus

Are you a dedicated CE truck driver with a passion for the construction industry? As a concrete mixer driver, you’ll deliver fresh concrete daily to various sites in the Antwerp and Brussels areas. You’ll operate a modern fleet and receive clear routes and delivery plans from central dispatch. Your main job is to safely load concrete at our production sites and deliver it on time to different construction locations. You’ll be the face of the company, ensuring proper handover of documents, communicating effectively with customers, and following specific guidelines for each delivery.

On a typical workday, you’ll start at one of our state-of-the-art production sites in Sint-Katelijne-Waver or Hemiksem. After loading your mixer, you’ll follow your designated route to the client, where you’ll deliver the concrete. Your day will include several trips within urban areas, sometimes with restricted access. In these cases, you’ll get extra instructions and support from dispatch. In between, you’ll make sure all transport documents are completed accurately and thoroughly. You work independently but can always rely on an experienced team for support.

Do you see yourself working in a well-organized company with a strong focus on quality and safety? Do you want to be part of a growing family business and enjoy competitive pay, extra benefits, and the possibility of a permanent contract? Apply today and become the driving force behind our concrete mixers!

• You have a valid CE driver’s license and a valid driver card

• You have experience as a CE driver, preferably with completing transport documents

• You speak and understand communicative English

• You are physically fit and motivated to work hands-on

• You are resilient and can confidently navigate complex routes, including urban settings

• You work accurately and appreciate clear agreements

• You’re willing to work a flexible schedule (including overtime possible)

About the Job : 

On behalf of our client working in the Financial Services Industry, we are look for a Credit Risk Analyst that will help assessing project viabilities and predictive model development and optimization : 

• In credit risk model analysis and maintainance 
• Code development and code testing to put in place new predictive models into the system 
• Ensuring good communication flows with Banking regulators 
• Ad hoc research on portfolio risk evolution 

About You :

• Master in an Analytics, Statistical, or Finance oriented field 
• Well versed in Microsoft Excel, Access

What will you have to do?

• You supply the raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.
 
• Converting machines is also part of your responsibilities, as is cleaning and maintaining the production line. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You have a degree as a chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef OR possess the necessary experience
 
• Recent graduates in the fields of chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef are also welcome
 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5:00 AM–1:00 PM / 1:00 PM–9:00 PM)
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English
 
• You are willing to undergo in-house training
 
• You have a truly hands-on attitude
 
• You are a team player

As a Production Team Lead, you will be responsible for the daily production of personalized cell therapies for both clinical and commercial use in a sterile cGMP environment. You will coordinate the different units within the CAR-T process and ensure that all activities are carried out safely and in full compliance with cGMP requirements — while steering and organizing the operations from your office-based workspace, keeping a strong overview of the production flow and acting as the central point of coordination for the team. If you don't have prior leadership experience yet, that is also okay. 
 

What you can expect: 
 

 
• Coordinate and supervise operational units within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Act as the first point of contact for production issues and collaborate closely with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
 
• Serve as a domain expert for Quality and Operations in cGMP environments and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
 
• Manage all quality-related production aspects, including procedures, work instructions, logbooks, transfer forms, batch record review and release, and overall cGMP compliance.
 
• Coordinate quality system activities such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
 
• Ensure proper training of team members and promote a culture of continuous learning.
 
• Drive operational excellence by initiating improvements that increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance overall quality. 

Who we are looking for: 
 

 
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.
 
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a GMP environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma. 
 
• Experience in people management, or with relatable coordinating activities such as training, coaching, ... .
 
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations and cleanroom operations; familiarity with Microsoft Office is required, and experience with MES/EBR is a plus.
 
• Strong communication and organizational skills. You don’t need formal leadership experience, but you do show natural leadership qualities.
 
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with strong attention to detail.
 
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

As a Production Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily production process of personalized cell therapy, both for clinical and commercial purposes. You will lead various units within the CAR-T process and ensure safe and compliant production activities in accordance with cGMP requirements — all while coordinating and overseeing operations from your dedicated office workspace, maintaining a clear overview of the production floor and ensuring smooth cross-team collaboration.
 

Tasks:
 

 
• Lead and supervise operational units within the CAR-T production process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Act as the primary point of contact for production-related topics, ensuring smooth coordination with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
 
• Provide hands-on leadership on the shop floor, supporting teams in daily operations, troubleshooting, and decision-making in cGMP environments.
 
• Serve as a subject matter expert for Quality and Operations and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
 
• Oversee production quality activities, including documentation management (procedures, work instructions, logs, transfer forms), batch record review and release, and compliance with cGMP standards.
 
• Coordinate quality system processes such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
 
• Guide and support team development through structured training and operational coaching.
 
• Drive operational excellence by leading process improvements focused on efficiency, cost reduction, and quality enhancement. 

Who we are looking for: 
 

 
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.
 
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a production environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma.
 
• Strong experience in management, for example as a production lead, supervisor, or similar leadership role.
 
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations, cleanroom operations, and familiarity with Microsoft Office; experience with MES/EBR systems is a plus.
 
• Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills with an empathetic and people-oriented management style.
 
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with a strong attention to detail.
 
• Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

For our client, a biotech company that is a fast-growing & innovative organization, we are looking for a warehouse associate.
 

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

As a warehouse associate your responsibilities are; 
 

Receiving biohazard products (blood bags, viral vectors, ...) in a controlled temperature environment.
 

Accurately process inventory receipts ensuring correct matching to purchase orders, documentation of approvals, quality checks and adherence to policies.
 

Working with equipment and material stored at cryogenic
 

Fill out the Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for incoming materials including: transport unloading, temperature control, integrity control, administrative paperwork related to following correct procedures.
 

Fill in forms & logbooks related to receiving, picking and outbound activities to comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) policies in the pharmaceutical environment.
 

Work closely together with the Operations and Quality department to support the Production and Lab activities for our start-up site. 
 

Work in a clean environment where you will wear dedicated gowning clothes.
 

Working in two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to process inbound, picking and outbound activities.
 

Collaborate with accounting, suppliers and business stakeholders in support of on-going operational efficiency efforts.
 

At Legend Biotech in Zwijnaarde, you will have the opportunity to participate in the production of advanced CAR-T cell therapies, an innovative form of cancer treatment. You will work in a highly technological GMP-regulated environment.
 

 
• Working daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment
 
• Ensuring the cleanliness of equipment and production areas 
 

Performing various steps within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including:
 

 
• Cell isolation
 
• Cell selection, activation, and transduction
 
• Cell culture
 
• Aseptic processing
 
• Filling and finishing operations
 
• Cryopreservation 
 

Manufacturing clinical and commercial ATMPs (Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products)
 

 
• Adhering to all applicable quality and safety standards 
 

Performing in-process controls on batch samples while maintaining the highest quality standards
 

Strictly following SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), batch records, and GMP guidelines
 

 
• Recording and managing GMP documentation to ensure compliance and traceability 
 

Supporting environmental monitoring and the maintenance of GMP production areas
 

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Who are you?
 

You are a detail-oriented team player who enjoys working in an innovative manufacturing environment.
 

You have:
 

 
• A Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biomedical Sciences, or an equivalent field
 
• Initial experience with cell culture
 
• Experience in a GMP environment and/or ATMP manufacturing is a strong asset
 
• Good command of English, both written and spoken
 
• Willingness to work in a shift-based system
 
• A hands-on mentality and strong attention to detail

• Sustainability & Circular Economy: De Beleyr actively promotes eco-friendly manufacturing. By extending component lifecycles through precise repairs and thermal coatings, clients achieve an average 85% reduction in  emissions and up to 75% cost savings compared to purchasing new OEM parts. All machining scraps and metal powders are 100% recycled.
• In-House Quality Control: Equipped with a dedicated measuring room, advanced measuring instruments (e.g., micrometers, precision gauges), and technical design software to validate tight tolerances for every single workpiece.
• Flexible & Custom Production: No monotone series production. The workshop processes single pieces, complex custom builds, and small repair batches ranging from intricate miniature components to massive industrial shafts.
Driven by a team of skilled machining specialists and continuous investment in automation and state-of-the-art machinery, De Beleyr Engineering guarantees high delivery reliability, short lead times, and top-tier craftsmanship.

 Required Experience:

• Practical experience with conventional cylindrical grinding is essential.
• Experience with manually setting up conventional cylindrical grinding machines independently.
• Experience with aligning and clamping workpieces correctly on the machine.
• Experience in performing measurements independently using accurate measuring tools, including micrometers.
• Experience working with high precision on a micrometer level.
• Experience reading and interpreting technical plans and mechanical drawings.
• Experience working with hard materials.
• Preferred experience with machine brands: Norton, TOS, and Danobat.
• Preferred experience or familiarity with diamond grinding wheels.
 Education & Qualifications:

• TSO level or equivalent.
• Technical education in areas such as:
• Metalworking 
• Machining 
• Mechanical Design / Shaping 
• Mechanical Engineering 
• Mechanical Techniques 
Note: Relevant practical experience is just as important as a diploma. Proven hands-on experience and technical insight carry more weight than formal qualifications.

 Competencies & Profile:

• Strong technical understanding and a good feel for machines and how workpieces react during grinding.
• Ability to work with high accuracy, control, and patience to bring workpieces step-by-step to the exact size.
• Strong focus on quality, preferring to deliver one perfect part over five parts that require subsequent rework.
• Solution-oriented mindset with the ability to identify and solve problems independently.
• Capable of working both independently with high autonomy and as part of a team.
• Driven, eager to learn, and stress resistant.
• Positive attitude, neat and safe working habits, and willing to get hands dirty.
• Professional and courteous appearance
• Willingness to be flexible regarding working hours/overtime when required.
• Language Requirements: Proficiency in English or German (Dutch is not mandatory).

jobs.occupation: Digital Marketing Intern – B2B Food Supplements
jobs.description:
Who we areFermedics is a Ghent-based scale-up making fermented botanical ingredients for food supplement brands. And we’re growing fast: in recent years we’ve roughly doubled every year. We’re riding two big waves at once, a booming supplements market and the fermentation trend. Small team, big ambitions, short communication lines. 
Your missionHelp us build a real digital marketing strategy. The basics are already there: our website, LinkedIn, Semrush for SEO/GEO analysis, newsletters and Canva. Now we need someone to bring it all together, including a content plan for our newsletter, Instagram and LinkedIn communication. 
What you’ll be doing
 
 

• SEO & GEO: dig into Semrush, spot the gaps and fix them, so both Google and LLM models like Claude & ChatGPT find us 

• Sales funnel & Campaigns: map out our funnel and set up campaigns across channels and drive conversions 

• Website: improve findability, structure and conversion 

• Content: social posts, blog posts, mailings and website copy 

• Instagram: yes, B2B. Our customers (supplement brands) are there, so we should be too. You’ll launch and grow our account 

• Influencers: get relevant influencers on board to boost our reach and visibility 

• Showcasing finished products: plan how we highlight products made with our ingredients across the website, LinkedIn and Instagram 

• Visuals: create eye-catching marketing material 
 

• A student or recent graduate in (digital) marketing, communication or a related field 

• Digital native: you know social media, content and SEO, and you’re curious about AI search 

• Strong writer in English (Dutch is a plus) 

• Creative, hands-on and independent; you like to own your projects 

• Interested in health, food (supplements) or science? Then you’ll like it here!

jobs.occupation: Junior Business Assistant – Research & Development | P&G
jobs.description:
Contract Type: Temporary, part-time assignment (50%) Duration: 23 November 2026 – 22 November 2027 Working Schedule: Alternating two-week schedule: 

 
•  
 Week 1: 3 working days of 8 hours each (24 hours) 

 
•  
 Week 2: 2 working days of 8 hours each (16 hours)

We are looking for a Junior Business Assistant to join the Research & Development (R&D) department of a leading multinational consumer goods company. In this entry-level role, you will provide essential administrative and operational support to R&D teams and managers, helping ensure smooth and efficient day-to-day business operations. You will work in a dynamic, international environment where you will collaborate with different teams, navigate multiple systems, and contribute to continuous process improvement. 

As a Junior Business Assistant, you will play an important role in supporting the daily operations of the R&D department. Your responsibilities will include: 

 
• Calendar & Meeting Management: Schedule appointments, coordinate meetings, book meeting rooms, prepare agendas, and organize business travel. 
 
•  
 Travel & Expense Management: Arrange business trips, process expense reports, and ensure that travel-related administration is handled accurately and efficiently. 

 
• Administrative & Operational Support: Maintain databases and documentation, track team members' absences, order office supplies, and place and manage purchase orders. 
 
•  
 Communication & Employee Support: Act as a point of contact for employees, respond to questions, and ensure information is communicated accurately and in a timely manner. 

 
• Project Assistance: Provide ad hoc administrative and operational support for ongoing projects, team activities, and events. 
 
• Process Improvement & Documentation: Proactively identify opportunities to simplify and improve existing processes, and contribute to documenting and optimizing work procedures. 
 
• Systems & Data Management: Work with multiple digital platforms and data sources, including SAP and internal and external data portals, ensuring that information remains accurate and up to date. 

We are looking for an enthusiastic, eager-to-learn individual who takes initiative, adapts quickly to changing priorities, and enjoys helping others. The ideal candidate will have: 

 
•  
 Education: A high school diploma or equivalent. A degree or qualification in Business Administration, Office Management, or a related field is an advantage. 

 
•  
Digital Skills: Excellent knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel. Familiarity with SAP and other business applications is a plus. An interest in using AI tools to improve efficiency is also desirable. 

 
• Organizational Skills: The ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously, maintain an overview of ongoing activities, and meet deadlines. 
 

 
• Proactive Mindset: A hands-on approach, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to independently identify opportunities for improvement. 
 
• Agility & Flexibility: The ability to adapt to changing priorities and work confidently across multiple systems, processes, and information sources. 
 
• Attention to Detail & Discretion: A structured and accurate way of working, with the ability to handle confidential information responsibly. 
 
•  
 Communication & Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate clearly and work effectively with different stakeholders. 

 
• Process-Oriented Thinking: An interest in simplifying and improving workflows, with the ability to document processes clearly and accurately. 
 
•  
 Language Skills: Good written and spoken English.

Are you an experienced .NET DevOps Engineer with strong skills in ASP.NET Core and Azure DevOps pipelines ?

The team works transversally across the organization and focuses on making the Azure Cloud platform accessible, scalable and easy to use for other development teams. You will work in a multidisciplinary team following Agile, Scrum and SAFe methodologies.

• Create and maintain technical documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing.

• Continuously improve development processes, software quality and technical solutions.
• Stay up to date with relevant technologies and industry best practices.
Profile
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role.
• Strong experience with .NET, C# and ASP.NET Core.
• Solid experience with Azure DevOps and Azure Cloud.
• Experience with CI/CD, YAML pipelines, PowerShell and Bicep.
• Experience working in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
• Strong technical coaching and mentoring abilities.
• Adaptability and a continuous learning mindset
 
Nice to Have
At least 1 year of experience with:

• WCF
• Blazor
• gRPC
• GitHub EnterpriseLanguages
• Dutch or French: Native level
• Second national language (Dutch or French): Basic written and spoken communication
• English: Good comprehension.
